arc: A day of sky mirrored by a day of sheen. Titles (sky in letters ↔ metal in letters) → first light: sunrise, pad-light bokeh and a flat horizon ↔ gallium beads, a mirror lake and crystals → the drop: wind tears the clouds ↔ soap films race → glitter → cumulus builds ↔ molds grow → storm heads and lightning ↔ slime molds → the second drop: the Earth streams past the shuttle ↔ films stream → the eye of the storm and the sun's disc ↔ spirals and sporangia → full speed: aurora and racing clouds ↔ interference bands and metal → golden hour ↔ gold molds and molten gold → fog and slick → a hush (drums out) → a lens flare ↔ a glint on the drop → night orbit ↔ metal → the sun on the Earth's rim ↔ light on a bubble's rim (drums out) → all the light at once → the last gold.

Break: spirals and discs from above
Peak: aurora bands and racing clouds ↔ interference bands and metal
Groove: gold and orange skies ↔ gold molds and molten gold
Peak: fog pours, clouds race ↔ oil slicks and films drift
Drums out: one slow sky ↔ one slow crystal (holds 3 bars)
Drums back in on the drop: a lens flare ↔ a glint on foil
Peak: night passes and aurora ↔ metal and ferrofluid
Drums out: the sun on the rim of the Earth ↔ light on the rim of a bubble (holds 3 bars)
Final peak: everything returns at speed
